Mongolia nobody from the Kazakh/Tsardom edge to Manchuria (Cliopatria draws a Golden Horde and Khoshut there, not usable); Mongol Khanate patch, a small Tumed disc on Ming's northern edge, Ming, Haixi/Jianzhou Jurchens, Joseon and Japanese clans as drawn; the Mongolia gap is a dossier request

Safavids across Iran and the Gulf coast, Bukhara in Transoxiana, Kazakh Khanate and Georgian states as the dossiers state; Afghanistan (Kabul, Kandahar) is nobody where Cliopatria draws one large Timurid shape, noted under the Arghun item; the Aq Qoyunlu transfers read plausibly

Denmark-Norway (Denmark, Norway, Scania) drawn in the pale vassal tint (inverted Holstein relation; fixed by events/0); Hungary hatched as occupied, HRE members and the Ottoman, Jagiellon and Moscow borders as the dossiers state

Mughal reduced to a strip after Kannauj and Sur holds Delhi and the plains, Arghun in Sindh, Bikaner, Jaisalmer, Marwar and Mewar as the dossiers state; Cliopatria's Mughal row still draws the large Punjab block and runs to 1546, the source of keyframe_overrides/3

Imereti drawn as one block from the Black Sea coast down to the Ottoman and Safavid borders, holding the old Samtskhe land (Akhaltsikhe, down to the Erzurum edge), which the Samtskhe page makes an Ottoman vassal after Sokhoista (events/1); Kartli, Kakheti and Artsakh in Safavid tints

Viceroyalty of Peru in the colony tint with darker patches of direct Spanish Empire land inside it (Bolivia and northern Chile); cosmetic, left; Colonial Brazil coast strip and Captaincy General of Guatemala as drawn

Khorasan, Herat and Merv grey (nobody) between the Safavids and the Transoxiana-only Bukhara shape, three years before the Safavid return; Khiva occupied (hatched), Kazakh Khanate, Sibir and the Tsardom's additions as drawn; fixed by keyframe_overrides/1-2

Funj beside an independent Abdallab in its own colour (fixed by events/2); Habesh Eyalet in the Ottoman vassal tint, Ethiopian Empire, a small Adal core at Harar, Ajuran and Kathiri as the dossiers state
after the patch: Bukhara holds the Herat and Khorasan block inside the Safavid shape through 1596 and Khiva stays occupied
after the patch: Denmark-Norway in its own direct colour over Denmark, Norway and Scania, with a paler vassal patch at the German border (Schleswig); no vassal tint on the realm

issues.what: Denmark-Norway (about 2,900 cells) was drawn as a vassal of the Duchy of Holstein for 1526-1599 and beyond: ledger/3 of duchy-of-holstein opens a vassal relation before Denmark-Norway exists, so the compile read Holstein as suzerain. The page gives Holstein no overlordship (State of the HRE; personal union with Denmark 1474-1544). Closed in 1526 when Denmark-Norway is born; Holstein's 34 cells pass to Denmark-Norway as in the published draft

Songhai kept the old empire (about 4,135 cells: Agadez, Kayes, Hodh ech Chargui) for 1591-1594 because the Cliopatria row of the 1564 shape runs to 1594 and overlaps the 1591 Dendi keyframe; shape now ends 1590, as the dossier note says (Tondibi was fought in March 1591)

Khorasan and Herat (about 1,740 cells) fell to nobody in 1595-1597 because the Transoxiana-only Bukhara 1595 shape began three years before the Safavid return of 1598; the 1588 shape (with Khorasan and Merv) now holds to 1597 and the 1595 shape applies 1598-1599 with the Merv oasis (294 cells) unioned in so Merv is not dropped to nobody before the Safavid gain of 1600

About 1,050 cells of the Punjab stayed Mughal in 1541-1546 after Kannauj and Humayun's exile, because the Cliopatria row of the 1540 shape runs to 1546; shape now valid 1540 only, as the dossier note says. The Mughal still holds about 335 cells in 1541-1544 from other rows, left

The Aq Qoyunlu 1502 shape (Iran included) stayed in force to 1506 although the dossier replaces it from 1503 with a Mesopotamia-and-Diyar-Bakr shape; the shape now ends 1502 and Kerman, which the page says Ismail took in the summer of 1503 but the Safavid ledger lacks, goes to the Safavids by event. About 2,080 cells of lost Aq Qoyunlu land then stay nobody 1503-1506 until the Safavid keyframe of 1507 (the dossiers give no earlier owner)

Lithuania kept about 1,090 cells of Chernigov, Novgorod-Seversk, Starodub and the upper Oka for 1503-1506 after the truce of 25 March 1503 because the Cliopatria row of the 1502 shape runs to 1506; shape now ends 1502
Adal kept about 1,680 highland cells until 1546 although the war ended in 1543-1544 and the dossier's Harar-core keyframe starts 1544; shape now ends 1543
The Sur Empire kept its whole 1572 shape (about 1,340 cells) through 1578 although the dossier replaces it in 1574 and 1577 (Orissa alone); shape now ends 1573

The Abdallab were drawn partly independent beside Funj (only 79 of their cells took the vassal tint, 530 cells of River Nile and Khartoum were independent) although the page says Funj defeated them in 1504 and they ruled the Butana as vassals; the whole Abdallab shape is now the Funj vassal from 1504

After Sokhoista (1545) Samtskhe land stayed Imereti's on the map until the Ottoman keyframe of 1579, because the Samtskhe dossier ends in 1535 and hands its land to Imereti; the page makes Samtskhe an Ottoman vassal. Drawn as Ottoman land from 1545, the nearest the dossiers allow; the surviving Jaqeli principality is a dossier request

Samtskhe-Saatabago ends in 1535 in its dossier, but the page keeps a Jaqeli principality, Ottoman vassal from 1545, until 1625-1628 (the Ottoman keyframe of 1579 then absorbs the land); one dossier fix would let events/1 be replaced by a proper vassal drawing

Mongolia is nobody from 1547 to 1635 except a small Mongol Khanate patch: mongol-khanate stops in 1547 and khalkha-khanates starts only in 1636; the Khalkha page could not date the 16th-century Khalkha homeland, so no keyframe could be written from it

Arghun rule at Kandahar 1507-1520 has no dossier row (arghun-dynasty starts 1520), and in the compiled 1512 picture Afghanistan (Kabul, Kandahar) is nobody where Cliopatria draws one large Timurid shape; no page was opened on it, so only noted
Erzurum and Kars are held by Samtskhe 1507-1534 in the size-rule conflict against the Ottomans; no page opened says which was right
In 1599 mughal-empire/ledger/60 draws 56 cells as Mughal land occupied by the Khandesh Sultanate, the roles reversed (the Mughals were the occupier); small, no page opened
Ming and Tumed overlap on 102 cells of Shanxi (1547-1595); the size rule hands them to Ming and no page opened contradicts it
Viceroyalty of Peru is drawn with small holes of direct Spanish Empire land inside it; cosmetic, same colour, no effect on ownership

Region names that the gazetteer does not resolve, so the lines drop from the replay: Nevel and Usvyaty (tsardom-of-russia, 1562-1582), Fatagar (adal-sultanate and ethiopian-empire, 1543-1544), Wej (ethiopian-empire, 1572), Tututepec (tututepec, 1522) and Cempoala (aztec-triple-alliance, 1519); each is a few cells and no page opened gives them in a form the gazetteer takes
Small overlaps left as the size rule settles them: ahmadnagar_1579, kingdom-of-france_1502, ai-viet, house-of-bourbon, lodi, vijayanagara; none moves a border by more than a few cells

Denmark-Norway winning Jamtland, the Kathiri over Hadramawt, the Bikaner and Lodi borders and Habsburg-Netherlands are drawn as the dossier notes state; checked against the pictures and the dossier notes (no page opened), nothing to change

The Safavid, Shaybanid and Aq Qoyunlu transfers of 1502-1512 read as the dossiers state once the Aq Qoyunlu 1502 shape ends; the Moscow-to-Tsardom handover of 1546 and the Tsardom's Siberian additions (Surgut and Tara 1594, Obdorsk 1595) are drawn as the dossiers state

dossier_requests.what: Carry the Khalkha homeland (Mongolia) through 1547-1635 with a confidence-1 keyframe (extend khalkha-khanates back to 1547, or mongol-khanate forward), so Mongolia is not nobody for 89 years
dossier_requests.why: mongol-khanate stops in 1547 and khalkha-khanates starts in 1636; the compiled map shows Mongolia grey for 1547-1635. The Khalkha page speaks of the Khalkha but gave no 16th-century dates in the text read, so the extent and the years need a dated source (another page, or the Mongol Khanate page for the Northern Yuan)

dossier_requests.what: Change the end of the dossier from 1535 to 1625-1628 and give the principality an Ottoman vassal relation from 1545, with the Jaqeli land kept as its own shape until the Ottoman annexation
dossier_requests.why: 'Samtskhe became vassal of the Ottoman Empire' after Sokhoista in 1545 and the page keeps a Jaqeli principality under Ottoman vassalage to 1625-1628; the dossier ends it in 1535 and hands the land to Imereti, which events/1 of this patch only partly undoes

problems: events/0 (duchy-of-holstein vassal_end 1526) reaches past 1599: it closes the Holstein relation for every later window, so Denmark-Norway is no longer drawn as Holstein's vassal in 1600 and after (about 2,900 cells change status in the 1600 anchor)

keyframe_overrides/2 (khanate-of-bukhara_1595, 1598-1599 with Merv) reaches past 1599: the 1 January 1600 anchor now has Merv (294 cells) as Bukhara's instead of the Safavids', and the Safavid Merv gain of 1600 then applies; the window of p1600-p1699 should expect this
end anchor p1600 compared with the published one: 360 cells change owner (mostly Merv, plus small Denmark-Norway, Kazakh and Mughal shifts) and 3174 more change status or suzerainty

hierarchy: no hierarchy.csv row found wrong in this window; one optional addition, duchy-of-holstein under denmark-norway for 1526-1544 (personal union), is not needed by the drawing and was not asked for: Holstein's land is Denmark-Norway's direct land from 1526 in the picture and the hierarchy row makes it only an HRE constituent

pages: 13 fetches, 12 distinct pages (Samtskhe-Saatabago was fetched twice); Khalkha gave no 16th-century dates and Abdullah Khan II said nothing about Herat, Merv or Abbas, so those points are left to dossier requests or to the Merv and Aq Qoyunlu pages
